item.title: Correction · Venue: Venue at 1155 4th St is tagged an apartment building in OpenStreetMap, but the…
item.description: Venue at 1155 4th St is tagged an apartment building in OpenStreetMap, but the city permit describes 'erect new 6 stories of 147 units condo building'. Whether the homes are rentals or owner-occupied is not settled by the sources read. Source: DBI permit 201108041792 (data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=201108041792); OpenStreetMap way 255652150.

item.title: Correction · Venue: The note about the nearby Edwin M. Lee Apartments now cites SF YIMBY (118…
item.description: The note about the nearby Edwin M. Lee Apartments now cites SF YIMBY (118 units, about 123,700 sq ft) in place of an unsourced 124,000 sq ft figure. The aerial photo credits were corrected: the NAIP credit names the Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, and the Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight. The Joe & The Juice entry now says the tenant's page names only the address, not the Venue building. The RentCafe-based manager and unit-mix statements are marked as not re-confirmed because that page returns 403. Source: SF YIMBY, 2021-05-09 (https://sfyimby.com/2021/05/new-affordable-housing-reaches-completion-at-1150-3rd-street-mission-bay-san-francisco.html); Joe & The Juice, 1155 4th Street (https://content.joejuice.com/locations/1155-4th-street); USDA NAIP imagery catalog record (https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/national-agriculture-imagery-program-naip-imagery); Wikimedia Commons, aerial photo file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg).

item.title: Added · Venue: Joe & The Juice's own location page lists a cafe at 1155 4th Street (juice…
item.description: Joe & The Juice's own location page lists a cafe at 1155 4th Street (juice, sandwiches and coffee). The page does not name the Venue building; we match the address to the ground floor of the Venue apartment building at 1155 4th St (OSM and DBI records). No opening date found. Source: https://content.joejuice.com/locations/1155-4th-street.
